name: 15Five
description: 15Five performance management integration covering users, groups, departments, people attributes, objectives (OKRs), check-ins, high fives, priorities, pulses, review cycles, 1-on-1s, vacations, and security audit events, via the 15Five Public API.

subdomain.label: Company Subdomain
subdomain.help_text: The subdomain of your 15Five workspace, e.g. "acme" for https://acme.15five.com.

api_key.label: API Access Token
api_key.help_text: Generate under Settings -> Features -> Integrations -> Public API in 15Five. Sent as a Bearer token.

updated_after.description: Only users updated on/after this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

updated_before.description: Only users updated on/before this date (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

order_by.description: Field to sort by: id, create_ts, update_ts, email, or employee_id. Prefix with "-" to reverse order.
